summary: The meeting discusses the coordination between PFC and FGFC mechanisms in edge nodes R1 and R5 to achieve congestion-free data transfer across data centers, detailing deployment scenarios including single-hole and multi-hole interconnections. Specific trials were conducted in Hangzhou, Jinghua, and Shanghai involving storage/computing separation and distributed inference, achieving over 95% computational efficiency while using FGFC-in-ONE and PFC in AIDC to guarantee RDMA performance.
